name: Continuity Receipt 0.4.0
body:
# Continuity Receipt 0.4.0

Signed release tag `v0.4.0` freezes commit `59b401a5634501b8ed6119c7e9679d9d7139c4c6`. It contains spec `continuity-receipt/0.4`, Python and Rust verifier tooling 0.4.0, 40 bundle vectors, 21 verification-receipt vectors, the 0.4 schema, and the conformance table.

Spec 0.4 carries an offer/accept binding through decision, execution, delivery, and settlement records. Both verifiers also add whole-shape checks and input limits so malformed input yields structured results. The tag is the frozen technical review surface; later changes on `main` are not part of it.

Install the published packages with `pip install continuity-receipt==0.4.0` or `cargo install continuity-receipt --version 0.4.0`. The hosted `https://api.whitemagic.dev/info` endpoint reports its own deployed version and supported specs; it is a separate release surface.

Known frozen-artifact issues: the PyPI 0.4.0 source distribution omits `CONFORMANCE_TABLE.md`, and the crates.io 0.4.0 short description still says 0.1–0.3. Both were corrected on `main` for a later package release. The published PyPI long description also retains pre-publication wording. Consult the signed tag and the current repository separately.

`TRUSTED` means the submitted record passed format and supplied-policy checks. A signature establishes what a key signed; it does not independently establish that the narrated work occurred.

Review entrypoints: `SPEC.md`, `CONFORMANCE_TABLE.md`, `THREAT_MODEL.md`, `REVIEW_BRIEF.md`, and `REVIEW_RESPONSE.md` at the signed tag.
